title: Test architecture, fixtures and coverage baseline
summary: Define shared scenario contracts, temporary project fixtures, runners, and coverage thresholds.
description: Create the reusable verification foundation for all later phases. Existing tests live in package-local `test/` directories and use Node's built-in `node:test`, but there is no cross-package fixture factory, integration runner, coverage policy, or scenario inventory. Add shared helpers that create isolated temporary `.planner` projects without touching user repositories, seed deterministic features/phases/tasks/requirements/handoffs, normalize API/MCP/Pi results, and clean up reliably. Define the public-surface inventory from PlanStore methods, server routes, MCP tools, Pi commands/tools, and Web UI loaders/actions; map each surface to scenarios and expected errors. Establish c8/V8 coverage collection and package-level thresholds while excluding generated dist/web-ui bundles and unavoidable bootstrap code. Preserve Node >=25, pnpm workspace conventions, deterministic timestamps/IDs where possible, and the project rule that Agent Plan remains the single planner source of truth.

tasks.title: Inventory public surfaces and define scenario matrix
tasks.description:
Enumerate current PlanStore operations, HTTP routes in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, MCP registrations in packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, Pi commands/tools/hooks in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, and Web UI route loaders/actions/components. Convert each surface into named positive, negative, lifecycle, and persistence scenarios with expected normalized outcomes, including feature/phase/task validation, requirements, handoffs, load/stop, repair, and resume. Keep the matrix in a test-owned format that later API/MCP/Pi runners can consume without redefining scenario definitions.

- Verified: pnpm test:matrix → 12/12 green; 0 harness mismatches; 127 surfaces referenced, 112 deferred.

tasks.title: Build isolated temporary planner fixtures
tasks.description:
Create reusable fixture helpers that initialize a temporary directory, write a valid `.planner` project, and seed deterministic features, phases, tasks, requirements, links, statuses, handoffs, stale archives, and invalid-input cases. Every test must own and clean its directory, never load or mutate a user's real project, and support both file-per-feature storage and legacy migration fixtures. Expose factories for empty, populated, terminal-phase, and resume-needed projects while preserving real PlanStore persistence.

---
**Completion summary:**
Created test/helpers/fixtures.mjs: temp-dir factory (mkdtemp, never touches user repos), cleanup registry + cleanupFixtures(), createPlannerFixture() with 6 deterministic seeds (empty, minimal, full, terminal, resume-needed, legacy-single-file), readPlanSnapshot() persistence helper, fixturePaths(). Uses real PlanStore/filesystem; fixed BASE_TIME timestamp; deterministic shortIds via createShortId seed. Verified: all seeds load, repair clean, auto-archive-on-done works (terminal + full fixtures), legacy features.json migration fixture present, cleanup drains registry.

tasks.title: Add shared runners, result normalization, and cleanup
tasks.description:
Implement common test utilities for starting/stopping the server, connecting MCP clients, hosting Pi adapter contexts, invoking operations, normalizing composite references/errors/status payloads, and comparing persisted snapshots. Handle dynamic ports, WebSocket disposal, subprocess termination, browser cleanup, timeouts, and failed-test diagnostics. Keep transport-specific details at the runner boundary so the same scenario matrix can execute against API, MCP, and Pi without accidental cross-test state.

---
**Completion summary:**
Created test/helpers/runner.mjs: normalized result shape ({ok,error,data,text}), normalizers for tool (MCP/Pi), HTTP, and core results; assertScenarioExpectations (ok/errorMatch/data/verify); per-harness executor registry with guards; runScenario and runHarnessSuite with CI-friendly reports; missingExecutors() matrix-coverage check. Created test/matrix-consistency.test.mjs: 9 tests validating surface inventory uniqueness (239 surfaces), scenario matrix coherence (45 scenarios, valid enums, surface refs resolve), fixture existence + entity counts + deterministic timestamps, runner expectation/normalization semantics, executor registry guards, and cleanup registry draining. All green with node --test.

tasks.title: Establish coverage collection and baseline commands
tasks.description:
Add package-level coverage commands using Node 25 V8/c8 for node:test suites and define source include/exclude patterns. Establish baseline reports before adding new suites, identify uncovered public paths, and document thresholds without hiding meaningful source behind broad exclusions. Add a root command that runs package tests and emits stable text/JSON/HTML reports suitable for CI, while keeping generated dist and copied Web UI bundles excluded.

---
**Completion summary (review rounds 3-5):**

Round 3: fixed baseline column mapping (node table is line%|branch%|funcs%) and made the executor-registry test honest.

Round 4: JSON + HTML CI reports — scripts/reporters/json.mjs (test:summary/fail → results.json, schemaVersion 2), scripts/report.mjs (pure deterministic LCOV→report.json+html, byte-determinism tested), test-all.mjs wiring (4 artifacts always emitted, exit code preserved), test/report.test.mjs (5 tests incl. e2e smoke). Fixed NODE_TEST_CONTEXT recursion guard and NODE_V8_COVERAGE profile bleed (nested unit run polluted integration coverage: 45.16% spuriously → isolated; integration honest at 60.90%).

Round 5 (this round): removed node's MaxListenersExceededWarning ('11 end listeners added to [TestsStream]') from full runs. Root cause: reporter plumbing — node's compose()+pipe() wiring adds ~4 'end' listeners to the TestsStream PER --test-reporter; with 3 reporters (spec + custom json + built-in lcov) the count crossed MaxListeners=10 and node warned. Reproduced in isolation (2 reporters → clean; 3 reporters → warning even with a single trivial test file; count always 11, independent of file count). Fix: dropped the built-in lcov reporter entirely — scripts/reporters/json.mjs now emits coverage.lcov itself from the test:coverage event (TEST:coverage carries full per-file arrays: lines {line,count}, branches, functions), replicating node's internal lcov reporter output byte-for-byte (verified: LF/LH/FNF/FNH/BRF/BRH totals IDENTICAL to built-in on same flags, incl. full DA line-level detail). test-all.mjs passes only 2 reporters and sets REPORT_LCOV_PATH for the reporter. Regression guard added to test/report.test.mjs e2e smoke: asserts stderr has no MaxListenersExceededWarning + coverage.lcov carries DA records and end_of_record.

Verified: pnpm test → 188/188 exit 0, 0 warnings, 45.21/74.38/61.01 ≥ 45/74/61; pnpm test:unit → 171/171 exit 0, 0 warnings, 44.95/73.04/59.80 ≥ 44/72/59; pnpm test:integration → 17/17 exit 0, 0 warnings, 60.90/66.92/65.37 ≥ 60/66/65. Artifacts in reports/{unit,integration,all}/ (gitignored). No commit/push.

---
**Completion summary:**
T227 done — package-level coverage commands + CI reports.

Deliverables:
- scripts/test-all.mjs: scope runner (all/unit/integration) — optional pre-build, coverage flags from test/coverage.config.mjs (include/exclude policy: dist dirs measured, web-ui bundles + cli.js bootstrap + test files excluded), 4 artifacts ALWAYS emitted to reports/<scope>/ (results.json, coverage.lcov, report.json, report.html) even on failure, original exit code preserved, baseline vs --gate thresholds.
- scripts/reporters/json.mjs: custom node:test reporter — results.json (schemaVersion 2) from test:summary/test:fail events (canonical counts identical to spec reporter) + coverage.lcov emitted from test:coverage events (byte-identical format to node's built-in lcov reporter, full DA line-level detail).
- scripts/report.mjs: pure deterministic generator — LCOV parse (LF/LH/FNF/FNH/BRF/BRH → per-file line/branch/function %), aggregation vs baseline with honest met flags, report.json + self-contained report.html (no timestamps, no JS).
- test/report.test.mjs: 5 tests — LCOV parsing (hand-computed fixtures, BRF:0 → pct null), buildReport aggregation, HTML content, byte-determinism, e2e smoke (spawns test-all unit --no-build, asserts artifacts + results.json summary matches spec + coverage met + no MaxListenersExceededWarning + LCOV DA records).
- .gitignore: reports/ rule (line 15).

Fixes during review rounds:
- Baseline column mapping (node table = line%|branch%|funcs%).
- NODE_TEST_CONTEXT recursion guard (nested test-all skipped files) — stripped in spawn env.
- NODE_V8_COVERAGE profile bleed (nested unit run polluted integration coverage 45.16% → isolated to separate dir; integration honest 60.90%).
- MaxListenersExceededWarning (11 'end' listeners on TestsStream): caused by 3rd --test-reporter (built-in lcov) — node's compose+pipe wiring adds ~4 'end' listeners per reporter; fixed by emitting LCOV from the json reporter itself (2 reporters only), regression-guarded in the e2e smoke test.

Verified (fresh builds): pnpm test:unit 171/171 exit 0 (44.95/73.04/59.80 ≥ 44/72/59); pnpm test:integration 17/17 exit 0 (60.90/66.92/65.37 ≥ 60/66/65); pnpm test 188/188 exit 0 (45.21/74.38/61.01 ≥ 45/74/61); pnpm test:matrix 12/12. Reports in reports/{unit,integration,all}/ (gitignored). Approved by reviewer (subagent 019f4757) after personal re-run. No commit/push (working tree on next).
